dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregularly shaped 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit high-contrast white perimeters with jagged, non-linear edge transitions surrounding dark central voids, primarily clustered across the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of localized solid white pixel clusters; a singular, high-intensity circular blob with high pixel concentration and no internal gradient is visible on the mid-left flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle; a secondary group of smaller annuli and the prominent solid blob on the left flank form an elongated trapezoidal geometric relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, solid high-intensity white circular spot on the mid-left flank that is distinct from the surrounding gradient-based ring topology.
